rules.source: Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD), Lei No. 13.709/2018 — http://www.planalto.gov.br/ccivil_03/_ato2015-2018/2018/lei/L13709.htm
rules.retrieved_snippet: LGPD establishes norms for the protection and processing of personal data in Brazilian national territory, protecting fundamental rights of freedom, privacy, honor and intimacy.

rules.source: Estatuto Digital da Criança e do Adolescente (ECA Digital), Lei No. 15.211/2025 — https://infograficos.camara.leg.br/eca-digital/
rules.retrieved_snippet: First Brazilian law with specific rules/punishments for digital platforms regarding children and adolescents. Any product/service likely to be accessed by minors must guarantee priority protection, best-interest-of-the-child as parameter, and high privacy/data-protection/security levels. Became enforceable 2026-03-17.

rules.source: Estatuto Digital da Criança e do Adolescente (ECA Digital), Lei No. 15.211/2025 — https://infograficos.camara.leg.br/eca-digital/
rules.retrieved_snippet: Platforms must adopt effective age-verification methods (not simple self-declaration) and have clear rules preventing sexual exploitation, cyberbullying, harmful-practice inducement, gambling promotion, and predatory advertising toward minors.

rules.source: Código de Defesa do Consumidor, Lei No. 8.078/1990 — https://www.consumidor.gov.br/pages/conteudo/publico/102
rules.retrieved_snippet: Establishes norms of protection and defense of the consumer, of public order and social interest.

rules.source: No enacted comprehensive AI statute as of September 2026 — PL 2338/2023 (Marco Legal da Inteligência Artificial) was approved unanimously by the Federal Senate on 10 December 2024 and sent to the Chamber of Deputies in March 2025, where it remains pending in the Special Commission awaiting the rapporteur's opinion and a floor vote expected in 2026. Not yet law — https://www25.senado.leg.br/web/atividade/materias/-/materia/157233
rules.retrieved_snippet: PL 2338/2023 establishes a risk-based regulatory framework (prohibited/high-risk/limited-or-moderate risk, modeled on the EU AI Act) with transparency, explanation, and contestation rights — approved by the Senate, pending Chamber of Deputies vote as of this research.

rules.source: Lei Brasileira de Inclusão da Pessoa com Deficiência (LBI / Estatuto da Pessoa com Deficiência), Lei No. 13.146/2015, Article 63 — https://www.planalto.gov.br/ccivil_03/_ato2015-2018/2015/lei/l13146.htm
rules.retrieved_snippet: Article 63 makes digital accessibility mandatory for websites maintained by government bodies and by companies with headquarters or commercial presence in Brazil. A new technical standard, ABNT NBR 17225, was launched to operationalize Article 63's requirements for websites and web applications.
